name: Churrito Loco
facts: Address: 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA
Hours: Mon–Thu 12:00p–10:00p, Fri–Sat 12:00p–11:00p, Sun 12:00p–10:00p
Game: Loco Match, a 90-second match-3 puzzle
Loco Match is free to play with no account needed
You need a free member account to save a score or claim a prize
Weekly board runs Monday through Sunday and resets every Monday
1st place on the weekly board wins 50% off your next order
2nd place wins 20% off your next order
One run of 4,150+ points wins 15% off your next order
Free Daily Spin: one spin per member per day
Spin prizes are good for 3 days at the South Gate location, one reward per visit
Rewards: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1100 pts Churros for the table
Match 3+ snacks = +10 each; 4 in a row +40; 5 in a row +100
Clear the Churrito Man for +150
Grilled Serrano costs you 25 points if you swipe it
Account needs name, phone number and email; one account per phone
Players must be 13 or older; under 18 need a parent's permission
Menu includes churros, street corn, fries, dogs and drinks
Instagram: @churritoloco
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're open Mon–Thu 12:00p–10:00p, Fri–Sat 12:00p–11:00p, and Sun 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 12:00p every day of the week.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: We close at 10:00p Sunday through Thursday, and at 11:00p on Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: Are you open on Sundays?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays are 12:00p–10:00p.

qa.q: Are you open late on weekends?
qa.a: Fri and Sat we're open until 11:00p.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app and it opens Google Maps to our South Gate spot.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff when you arrive.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show yet. Check the Call to order button in the app, or ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call in an order?
qa.a: The app has a Call to order button. I don't have the number yet, so ask staff at the counter if it isn't working.

qa.q: Can I order food in the app?
qa.a: I don't have in-app ordering details. You can browse the menu in the app, then order at the counter or use Call to order.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table QR ordering. Ask staff how to order.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info. Ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: We have Churros, Street Corn & Fries, Dogs, and Drinks. Scroll the Menu section in the app to see everything.

qa.q: What churros do you have?
qa.a: Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49, and the Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry, or chocolate.

qa.q: What are the plain churros?
qa.a: Plain Signature Churros come as 4 pieces rolled in cinnamon sugar for $7.99.

qa.q: What are Churro Bites?
qa.a: Mini filled churros, 10 pieces, with your choice of fillings, $9.49.

qa.q: What's the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: It's a cone made out of churro with ice cream, drizzle and topping, $9.49.

qa.q: What street corn do you have?
qa.a: Original Corn $7.49 (whole corn, mayo, cheese, butter, chili powder) and Hot Cheetos Corn $7.49 (whole corn, mayo, butter, hot Cheeto crumbs).

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Original Elote Fries $11.49 (fries topped with corn mixed in mayo, cheese and butter) and XL Chili Cheese Fries $16.49 (fries, chili, cheese, grilled onions).

qa.q: What hot dogs do you have?
qa.a: Flamin Dog $9.49 (all-beef dog, bacon, nacho cheese, hot Cheeto crumbs) and Churro Dog $9.49 (all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese).

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee $6.49, Watermelon Paleta Energy $7.99, Jamaica Agua Fresca $5.49, and Pumpkin Spice Horchata $8.49.

qa.q: What's in the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: A watermelon, chamoy and tajín mix with Red Bull. It's $7.99.

qa.q: What's the Jamaica Agua Fresca?
qa.a: A hibiscus flavored drink for $5.49.

qa.q: What's in the Abuelita iced coffee?
qa.a: Fresh brewed coffee, chilled, with Abuelita chocolate, $6.49.

qa.q: Do you have a spicy option?
qa.a: The Flamin Dog and Hot Cheetos Corn both use hot Cheeto crumbs, and the Watermelon Paleta Energy has chamoy and tajín. I don't have spice levels beyond that.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The churros, corn and drinks have no meat listed, but I don't have full ingredient details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have allergy or gluten-free info?
qa.a: I don't have allergy details. Please tell staff about any allergy before ordering.

qa.q: Are the prices in the app final?
qa.a: Prices come from our public menu and may change, so confirm in store.

qa.q: Do you have seasonal or holiday specials?
qa.a: Holiday specials may show up in the app when they're running. If you don't see one, ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Ask staff.

qa.q: Are there daily specials?
qa.a: I don't have daily specials listed. Check the app's Specials card or ask staff.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards club?
qa.a: Make a free member account with your name, phone number and email. You can play Loco Match first and sign up after your run to save your score.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No. Member accounts are free.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app shows an offer of a free churro with your next order for joining.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone. Multiple accounts are disqualified from the game.

qa.q: Is there an age limit?
qa.a: You need to be 13 or older, and if you're under 18 you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have kid mode details. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission to join.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn points from purchases and from the free Daily Spin, and trade them for rewards. Ask staff how many points a dollar earns, because I don't have that number.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number. Ask staff or check your rewards card in the app.

qa.q: Do I earn points for playing Loco Match?
qa.a: I don't have any points-for-playing info. The game gives you score points, which go on the weekly board and can win discounts.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 200 pts: Free churro. 400 pts: Free horchata. 700 pts: Free loaded churro. 1100 pts: Churros for the table.

qa.q: How many points for a free churro?
qa.a: A free churro costs 200 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free horchata?
qa.a: A free horchata costs 400 points.

qa.q: How many points for a loaded churro?
qa.a: A free loaded churro costs 700 points.

qa.q: What does 'Churros for the table' cost?
qa.a: It's 1100 points, our top reward.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and show your code on your phone at the counter. If you're not sure how, ask staff.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have any expiration info. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have levels listed for Churrito Loco. Ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have birthday reward info. Ask staff.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes, there's a referral program with a free churro as the gift. Ask staff or check the app for how it works.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for visiting or checking in?
qa.a: Show the counter this offer in the app for double stars on today's churros. I don't have other visit bonuses.

qa.q: How does the Daily Spin work?
qa.a: Open the free Daily Spin and spin the wheel. Every slice wins something, and you get one spin per member per day (Los Angeles time).

qa.q: Does the Daily Spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. It's always free, never costs tokens, and you can't buy spins.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 points, +100 points, +75 points, $1 off any churro, a free churro, a free horchata, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $1 off any churro 15%, free churro 8%, free horchata 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at our South Gate location, one reward per visit.

qa.q: Can I combine spin prizes with other rewards?
qa.a: No. They can't be combined with other rewards, have no cash value, and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do prizes include alcohol?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol, and the free horchata is non-alcoholic.

qa.q: What is Loco Match?
qa.a: It's our 90-second match-3 puzzle game. Swap snacks to line up 3 or more of the same kind and score as high as you can.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap, or swipe a snack toward its neighbor. A swap only sticks if it makes a match of 3 or more.

qa.q: Is Loco Match free?
qa.a: Yes. It's free to play for anyone, as often as you like, with no account needed.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. There's no limit on Loco Match runs.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Each run is 90 seconds.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Each snack in a match is +10. A 4-in-a-row adds +40, a 5-in-a-row adds +100, clearing the Churrito Man adds +150, and chain reactions add +15, +30, +45 and so on.

qa.q: What is the Churrito Man?
qa.a: He's our churro mascot tile. Make a match right next to him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano?
qa.a: A grilled serrano pepper. Don't swipe it. It costs you 25 points, and it burns out on its own.

qa.q: What is a chain reaction?
qa.a: When falling snacks make new matches on their own, you get +15, +30, +45 and more for each step.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: A golden tile that shows up once per run, about 20–40 seconds in. Match right next to it for a +300 bonus, then watch Antidote's review of Churrito Loco after your run.

qa.q: What's the video that plays during the game?
qa.a: After about 80–90 seconds of total play, your next run opens with a short break showing Antidote's review of Churrito Loco. You can skip it.

qa.q: Is there a weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: Yes. The weekly board runs Monday through Sunday and resets every Monday, with new winners each week.

qa.q: What do I win on the weekly board?
qa.a: 1st place wins 50% off your next order and 2nd place wins 20% off. A single run of 4,150+ points wins 15% off your next order.

qa.q: What score do I need to make the board?
qa.a: 4,150 points in one run makes the weekly board and wins 15% off your next order. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday. The week runs Monday through Sunday. I don't have the exact closing time, so ask staff.

qa.q: What happens if there's a tie?
qa.a: Ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: Join with a free account after your run to save your score. Winners may be asked to show the code on their phone and a matching account at the counter.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can I win by chance?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is a game of skill, and prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play Loco Match, spin the Daily Wheel, or win a prize, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Open the game, pair a Bluetooth or USB controller, and press any button. You'll find help under 'Play with a game controller'.

qa.q: Can I play in full screen?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Full screen option in the game's start menu or the ⛶ button during play.

qa.q: Are there game tokens?
qa.a: Not right now. Loco Match is free to play, and a spin never costs tokens.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use the Add to Home Screen link in the game menu or page footer. On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen. On Android, tap the ⋮ menu then Install or Add to Home screen.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 button to pick English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย, or Русский.

qa.q: Do you have a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card info. You can add the app to your Home Screen so your rewards are one tap away.

qa.q: Where can I see your Instagram?
qa.a: We're @churritoloco. Posts and reels are in the app, so scroll down to see them.

qa.q: Can I leave a review?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Google review button in the app. No rewards are given for reviews, so we only want honest ones.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: How do I stop texts or emails?
qa.a: Reply STOP to a text or unsubscribe from an email anytime. Opt-in messages can be stopped whenever you want.

qa.q: Do you share my location?
qa.a: Location stays on your phone, and the map only uses it to show how far you are from us.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter. Staff can help with rewards, orders and anything I don't know.
